dimensionAudit.fourPlusOneVerdict: a codimension-one wall in 4+1 dimensions has a 3+1-dimensional worldvolume and requires a second reduction; moreover the existing b2 wedge da1 action is a four-form, not a standalone five-dimensional action
dimensionAudit.chosenCompletion: 3+1-dimensional finite folded slab with a dynamical Z2 kink

abelianHiggsOnlyNoGo.statement: The charge-three scalar phases are gauge equivalent, so the gauge-inequivalent vacuum space is connected and has no pi_0 domain walls. The minimal Abelian Higgs action supplies codimension-two vortices, not the required codimension-one defect.
abelianHiggsOnlyNoGo.minimalExtraDatum: one neutral real Z2-odd order parameter eta, or externally imposed folding/orbifold boundary data

wall.orientationSelection: the CP/reflection-symmetric action gives equal kink and antikink tension; boundary conditions or formation history select a superselection sector but the law predicts no sign
wall.translationMode: eta_K prime is even and is projected out when eta is constrained odd under the fold, pinning the wall at y=0

reader.bulkField: one complex scalar Phi of compact-U1 charge one
reader.doublingVerdict: one complex bosonic mode is consistent; its antiparticle supplies charge two modulo three but is not a second mirror field
reader.anomalyVerdict: no bosonic parity anomaly; a single 2+1-dimensional fermionic reader would require a separate parity-anomaly/inflow audit
